at-0001.content: In ledgerly/invoice.py, wrap unit prices with to_money() and round results with round_money(), using ZERO as the sum seed instead of a bare 0 or float.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly/errors.py using the established codes: "invalid_state" for wrong invoice status, "invalid_quantity" for bad quantities, "negative_amount" for negative money.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0004.title: Exclude bool when validating integer arguments
at-0004.content: When validating an int parameter, check isinstance(value, bool) first because bool is a subclass of int; reject bools alongside non-ints and non-positive values.

at-0005.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0005.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` before comparing or doing arithmetic (as `subscriptions.current_period` does for `at` and `sub.started_at`).

at-0006.title: Compute periods with timedelta floor division
at-0006.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the way `subscriptions.current_period` does: build `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and use `(at - start) // length` to get the period index.

at-0007.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key checked first
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original record without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` call.
